header: Thirteen retrieval questions for the coffee R&D paper assistant. Status: candidates drafted 2026-11-02 from the research areas, trust problems and decline cases an R&D researcher confirmed on 2026-10-20 (use_case/axis_assumptions.md); q11-q13 added the same day for the health, IoT/digital and innovation areas the company named as priorities. The team has not yet sent its own list. Replace line by line when it arrives and rerun the comparison. 4 of 13 need two records (q04, q06, q07, q13), so top-1 retrieval cannot pass them: top-k floor is 2. Gold ids are OpenAlex work ids in use_case/data/scout.sqlite. u01-u05 are ASSUMED test questions written on 2026-11-03 in the voice of an R&D researcher, NOT from the Step 6 session: they stand in until a real researcher types five of their own. When that session happens, add the researcher's questions as r01-r05 (source: 'Step 6 session <date>, <role>') and drop or keep u01-u05 as test questions.

question: Which roast levels develop pleasant aroma notes and which ones develop burnt or sulfurous off-notes, according to work that uses the SCA roast classification?
source: drafted: roasting is a frequent request area (axis_assumptions.md section 2)

question: Why does anaerobic in-cherry fermentation give roasted coffee more fruity notes? Which compounds are responsible?
source: drafted: processing and fermentation is a frequent request area (axis_assumptions.md section 2)

question: Prolungare la fermentazione della mucillagine o ritardare la lavorazione dopo la raccolta aumenta l'ocratossina nel caffè?
source: drafted: the team works in Italian (CHARTER.md); tests whether retrieval crosses languages. Terms assume the answer comes back in the question's language

question: What can be done to reduce ochratoxin A in coffee, from good practice on the farm to biological control during fermentation?
source: drafted: food-safety question spanning a review and one experimental study; W4405184446 has a truncated abstract, which retrieval may miss

question: Between Castillo and Caturra, which arabica variety copes better with heat and drought, and do the plants recover after rewatering?
source: drafted: agronomy, varieties and climate is an occasional request area (axis_assumptions.md section 2); variety names are exact identifiers that favour keyword search

question: Can shade trees or agroforestry protect coffee growing areas from climate change, and does it work equally for arabica and robusta?
source: drafted: needs two studies with different conclusions (Uganda: no offset for arabica; Rwanda: shade corridor feasible)

question: How long does roasted coffee keep its quality in different packaging, and what happens to coffee in compostable capsules during storage?
source: drafted: packaging and shelf life is an area with no schema category (axis_assumptions.md section 2)

question: How long does a pasteurised cold brew coffee stay stable in the fridge, and does the roast level of the beans matter?
source: drafted: extraction and brewing is an area with no schema category (axis_assumptions.md section 2)

question: Are consumers in Germany willing to pay more for coffee whose sustainability certification is backed by digital traceability?
source: drafted: sustainability and certification is a frequent request area (axis_assumptions.md section 2)

question: What acrylamide levels did our own roasted blends show in last quarter's internal lab tests?
source: drafted: the corpus holds published papers, never the company's own lab data; a hard decline because acrylamide is heavily covered in the corpus. Pass means it refuses and quotes no figure

question: How much caffeine is in a typical takeaway coffee compared with a homemade one, and can drinking 3-5 cups a day push someone over the safe daily intake?
source: drafted: health is a priority area the company named on 2026-11-02; a consumer-safety question with exact numbers

question: Can a camera on an automatic espresso machine judge the crema and adjust the brewing in real time?
source: drafted: IoT and digital technology is a priority area the company named on 2026-11-02

question: What have coffee by-products been turned into: can cascara work as an edible food coating, and what nutrients do spent coffee grounds and silverskin contain?
source: drafted: innovation and by-product valorisation is a priority area the company named on 2026-11-02; needs one experimental study and one review

question: Per l'estrazione conta di più la durezza dell'acqua (calcio e magnesio) o l'alcalinità (bicarbonato)? Cosa succede al gusto?
source: assumed for testing (2026-11-03), not from a real researcher; replace with the Step 6 session; Italian, water chemistry for brewing recommendations

question: Do capsule coffees release PFAS into the cup, and does the brewing method make a difference?
source: assumed for testing (2026-11-03), not from a real researcher; replace with the Step 6 session; food-contact safety of capsules

question: If we heat or cool the beans just before grinding, what happens to the espresso's caffeine and aroma?
source: assumed for testing (2026-11-03), not from a real researcher; replace with the Step 6 session; grinder and bean temperature in production

question: Can near-infrared spectroscopy replace GC-MS to check the roast degree on the line, and can it predict the volatile compounds?
source: assumed for testing (2026-11-03), not from a real researcher; replace with the Step 6 session; fast quality control on the roasting line

question: Does a slow low-temperature roast keep more chlorogenic acids than a fast high-temperature one?
source: assumed for testing (2026-11-03), not from a real researcher; replace with the Step 6 session; health claims linked to roast profile
